valor: A body tries to recognize itself through what it lacks. As it measures its contours, breaks apart and comes back together, the absence of a horse opens a question about desire, memory and identity.
motivo: síntesis 26 nov (redactor 3 26 nov; verifica verificador 3 26 nov): equivale a la corta en español

antes.cinetoro-2026: Trying to understand what a body without a horse is by seeing what it’s capable of, the film shows a very present absence. With minimalist and handcrafted visuals, we follow the body as it performs a series of actions, yet remaining horseless. Playing with choreographic movements, language and its metaphors, the film explores how absence can shape the way we move, desire, forget and remember.
